image_prompts: A clipboard with a checklist and a pen, representing data collection.
A graph showing different percentages, illustrating the results of a study.
words.image_desc_en: A clipboard with checklist and pen; a graph showing percentages.
words.image_desc_cn: 带有清单和笔的剪贴板；显示百分比的图表。
words.usage: n. / v. (过去式 surveyed, 过去分词 surveyed)
words.collocations: conduct a survey, carry out a survey, online survey

examples.en: We did a survey about students' opinions on school lunches.
examples.cn: 我们做了一项关于学生对学校午餐意见的调查。

examples.en: The company surveyed its employees to find out their needs.
examples.cn: 公司调查了它的员工，以了解他们的需求。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想了解同学们对新校规的看法，你会怎么做？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 需要收集大量数据，了解每个人的想法。

sentences: The school conducted a ___ to gather feedback on the new uniform.

image_prompts: A ruler precisely measuring a wooden block to a specific dimension
A gold medal with the inscription 'Quality Standard' on a dark background
words.image_desc_en: A ruler measuring a block and a gold medal.
words.image_desc_cn: 一把尺子测量一个木块和一枚金牌。
words.usage: n. pl. standards; adj. (比较级 more standard, 最高级 most standard)
words.collocations: high standard, meet the standard, standard of living

examples.en: The school has a high standard for student behavior.
examples.cn: 这所学校对学生的行为有很高的标准。

examples.en: This essay is below the standard required for this class.
examples.cn: 这篇文章低于这门课要求的标准。

socratic_questions.question: 描述一个衡量事物好坏的参考依据，比如考试及格线或产品质量要求。
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 它代表着被普遍接受的、衡量事物的基准。

sentences: The company sets a high ___ for its products to ensure quality.

image_prompts: A group of colorful canoes lined up on a calm lake, paddles resting inside
A neat line of planted seedlings in a garden, evenly spaced and watered
words.image_desc_en: Images showing a line of canoes and a line of seedlings.
words.image_desc_cn: 展示一排独木舟和一排秧苗的图片。
words.usage: n. / v. (过去式 rowed, 过去分词 rowed)
words.collocations: in a row, row a boat

examples.en: We sat in the front row to see the show clearly.
examples.cn: 我们坐在前排，为了清楚地观看演出。

examples.en: They decided to row the boat across the small lake.
examples.cn: 他们决定划船穿过这个小湖。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想让植物排列整齐，你会怎么做？或者，在电影院里，你坐在哪里能更好地观看电影？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 考虑整齐排列或位置的概念。

sentences: The students sat in a ___ during the assembly in the hall.

image_prompts: Three identical trophies lined up on a polished wooden shelf, side view
A series of colorful houses standing next to each other, each with a unique design
words.image_desc_en: Items or structures arranged linearly and consecutively.
words.image_desc_cn: 物品或结构线性且连续地排列。
words.usage: 短语。表示事物连续排列或连续发生。
words.collocations: sit in a row, win in a row, stand in a row

examples.en: We sat in a row at the cinema, enjoying the movie.
examples.cn: 我们在电影院里一排坐着，享受着电影。

examples.en: The team won three games in a row last month.
examples.cn: 上个月，这个队伍连续赢了三场比赛。

socratic_questions.question: 想象一下，运动会上，同学们一个接一个地跑过终点线，这是什么情况？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 强调动作的连续性，一个接着一个发生。

sentences: The students stood ___ waiting for the teacher's instructions.

image_prompts: A close-up of a computer keyboard with colorful keys, soft lighting
An old-fashioned typewriter with dusty keys and a blank sheet of paper
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting a computer keyboard and an old typewriter.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘电脑键盘和老式打字机的图像。
words.collocations: computer keyboard, virtual keyboard, keyboard shortcut
words.preposition_combos: on the keyboard, at the keyboard

examples.en: I use the keyboard to type emails to my friends.
examples.cn: 我用键盘给我的朋友们发邮件。

examples.en: The keyboard is an important part of the computer system.
examples.cn: 键盘是电脑系统中重要的组成部分。

socratic_questions.question: 当你需要输入文字到电脑时，你会使用什么设备？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个设备有很多按键，每个按键代表一个字母或符号。

sentences: She spilled coffee on her ___ and now some keys don't work.

image_prompts: A numbered list with '1' highlighted, followed by other points.
A starting line with a banner that reads 'First Step'.
words.image_desc_en: A numbered list highlighting the initial step and a starting line emphasizing the beginning.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个编号列表，突出显示初始步骤；以及一个起跑线，强调开始。
words.collocations: First of all, consider...

examples.en: First of all, let's discuss the main points of the project.
examples.cn: 首先，让我们讨论这个项目的主要内容。

examples.en: First of all, I want to thank everyone for their hard work.
examples.cn: 首先，我想感谢大家辛勤的工作。

socratic_questions.question: 当你要开始列举一系列事情时，你会用什么短语来引出第一个要点？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语表示在所有事情之前，最先要做的事情。

sentences: ___, we need to make a plan before we start the work.

image_prompts: A golden trophy with confetti falling around it, celebratory atmosphere
A greeting card with 'Congratulations' written in elegant script, surrounded by flowers
words.image_desc_en: Images representing success and celebration.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表成功和庆祝的图像。
words.collocations: congratulate someone on something

examples.en: I want to congratulate you on passing your driving test.
examples.cn: 我想祝贺你通过了驾驶考试。

examples.en: We should congratulate her on winning the first prize in the contest.
examples.cn: 我们应该祝贺她在比赛中获得一等奖。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你的朋友取得了一个很大的成就，你会对他说什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示对他人成就的喜悦和赞赏。

sentences: We should ___ her on her excellent performance in the exam.

image_prompts: A glass of water with condensation on a hot day, sunlight reflecting
A dry, cracked desert landscape stretching to the horizon, heat haze
words.image_desc_en: A glass of water and a dry desert landscape.
words.image_desc_cn: 一杯水和干燥的沙漠景观。
words.collocations: feel thirsty, get thirsty, make someone thirsty

examples.en: After the long run, I felt very thirsty for water.
examples.cn: 长跑之后，我感到非常口渴，想喝水。

examples.en: The hot weather made everyone in the class thirsty.
examples.cn: 炎热的天气让班里的每个人都感到口渴。

socratic_questions.question: 当你长时间运动或者在炎热的环境中，身体会发出什么信号，让你想喝水？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个信号表明身体需要补充水分。

sentences: After playing basketball for two hours, he was very ___.

image_prompts: A parched desert landscape with cracked earth and a shimmering mirage in the distance
A dry sponge soaking up water from a puddle, the sponge expanding in size
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting extreme dryness and a strong desire for water or something else.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘极度干燥和对水或其他东西的强烈渴望的插图。
words.usage: 短语 v. to have a strong desire for something
words.collocations: be thirsty for knowledge, be thirsty for success, be thirsty for adventure

examples.en: He is thirsty for knowledge and always reads many books.
examples.cn: 他渴望知识，总是读很多书。

examples.en: The team is thirsty for victory after losing the last game.
examples.cn: 在输掉上一场比赛后，这支队伍渴望胜利。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你长时间没有喝水，你会感觉怎么样？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种感觉类似于对某事物的强烈渴望。

sentences: After years of hard work, she was ___ success and recognition.

image_prompts: A cornucopia overflowing with colorful fruits and vegetables, autumn leaves scattered around
A handwritten thank you note on elegant stationery, a fountain pen resting beside it
words.image_desc_en: A scene depicting gratitude through harvest abundance and a thank you note.
words.image_desc_cn: 通过丰收的景象和感谢信来表达感激之情。
words.usage: adj. feeling or expressing gratitude; appreciative
words.collocations: be thankful for, thankful heart, deeply thankful

examples.en: I am thankful for my family's support during the exam period.
examples.cn: 我感谢我的家人在考试期间给予的支持。

examples.en: She felt thankful that the rain stopped before the school sports day.
examples.cn: 她感到庆幸，运动会前雨停了。

socratic_questions.question: 当你收到一份礼物或帮助时，心里会涌起什么感觉？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种感觉表达了对他人给予的恩惠的肯定和感激。

sentences: We are all very ___ for the teachers' hard work.

image_prompts: A greeting card with the words 'Thank You' written in elegant calligraphy, surrounded by delicate floral patterns.
A hand holding a small, wrapped gift with a ribbon, set against a background of soft, warm light.
words.image_desc_en: A card expressing gratitude and a hand holding a gift.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张表达感谢的卡片和一只拿着礼物的的手。
words.usage: v. 表示对某人表示感谢的心情或行为。
words.collocations: be deeply thankful to, be eternally thankful to

examples.en: I am thankful to my parents for their endless support.
examples.cn: 我感谢我的父母给予我无尽的支持。

examples.en: We should be thankful to those who help us in need.
examples.cn: 我们应该感谢那些在我们有需要时帮助我们的人。

socratic_questions.question: 当你收到一份礼物或得到帮助时，你会对给予你礼物或帮助的人有什么样的感觉？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种感觉表达了你对他们的感激之情。

sentences: I ___ my teacher for helping me improve my English skills.

image_prompts: A series of numbered steps leading to a final destination, focus on the last step
A timeline showing events in chronological order, with emphasis on the final event
words.image_desc_en: A final step in a sequence; the last event on a timeline.
words.image_desc_cn: 序列中的最后一步；时间线上的最后一个事件。
words.collocations: lastly but not least

examples.en: First, add the eggs; then, the flour; lastly, add milk.
examples.cn: 首先，加入鸡蛋；然后，加入面粉；最后，加入牛奶。

examples.en: We discussed the budget, the schedule, and, lastly, the staff.
examples.cn: 我们讨论了预算、日程，以及最后，员工。

socratic_questions.question: 在列举一系列步骤或项目后，你想用一个词来表示这是最后一个，你会用什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示顺序上的最终位置。

sentences: We need to buy bread, milk, and, ___ , some fruit.

image_prompts: A clipboard with a checklist of items marked as completed, representing a set of duties
A jigsaw puzzle with several pieces already connected, symbolizing a challenge to be completed
words.image_desc_en: A checklist and a jigsaw puzzle, representing a set of duties and a challenge to be completed.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个清单和拼图，分别代表一组任务和一项需要完成的挑战。
words.usage: n. a piece of work that needs to be done, especially one that is difficult or unpleasant or that must be done regularly
words.collocations: difficult task, easy task, complete a task, assign a task

examples.en: Our main task is to finish the project before the deadline.
examples.cn: 我们的主要任务是在截止日期前完成这个项目。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a difficult task to complete at home.
examples.cn: 老师给我们布置了一个很难的家庭作业。

socratic_questions.question: 如果老师布置了一项需要你在家完成的作业，你会怎么称呼它？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词通常指需要努力完成的工作。

sentences: Completing this science project is a challenging ___ for the whole group.

image_prompts: A road stretching into the distance with a sign pointing forward
An arrow pointing forward on a map, indicating progress
words.image_desc_en: A road stretching into the distance and an arrow pointing forward.
words.image_desc_cn: 一条延伸到远方的道路和一个指向前方的箭头。
words.collocations: go ahead, look ahead, plan ahead

examples.en: We walked ahead to find a good place to rest.
examples.cn: 我们走到前面去寻找一个休息的好地方。

examples.en: She is always planning ahead for her future career.
examples.cn: 她总是在为她未来的职业生涯做计划。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想超过某人，你会怎么做？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 需要表达“在...前面”的状态。

sentences: The car sped ___ on the highway, leaving others behind.

image_prompts: A racing car speeding on a track, leaving other cars behind in a cloud of dust
A hiking boot stepping onto the summit of a mountain, with a panoramic view stretching far below
words.image_desc_en: Representing being in a leading position or further forward.
words.image_desc_cn: 表示处于领先地位或更靠前的位置。
words.collocations: stay ahead of, get ahead of, be ahead of schedule
words.preposition_combos: ahead of time, ahead of schedule

examples.en: She finished the project ahead of the deadline, which was great.
examples.cn: 她在截止日期之前完成了项目，这太棒了。

examples.en: Our team is working hard to stay ahead of the competition now.
examples.cn: 我们的团队正在努力工作，以保持领先于竞争对手。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你比其他人更早完成任务，或者在比赛中跑在最前面，你会用哪个短语来描述这种状态？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语表示在时间和位置上都处于领先地位。

sentences: He arrived at the meeting ___ everyone else, eager to present his ideas.

image_prompts: A gift box tied with a ribbon, accompanied by a greeting card
A backpack filled with books and a water bottle for a hiking trip
words.image_desc_en: A gift box with a card; a backpack with hiking essentials.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个带贺卡的礼品盒；一个装有徒步旅行必需品的背包。
words.collocations: go along with, come along with

examples.en: She brought her friend along with her to the party.
examples.cn: 她把她的朋友一起带到了聚会上。

examples.en: I will take my umbrella along with me because it might rain.
examples.cn: 我会带上我的雨伞，因为它可能会下雨。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你要参加一个活动，并且邀请了你的好朋友和你一块去，你会怎么说？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语表示“一起，连同”的意思，暗示你和朋友共同参与。

sentences: He ordered a pizza ___ a salad for his lunch today.

image_prompts: A well-organized desk with labeled folders and a task list.
A sturdy bridge designed with precision and care, ensuring safety.
words.image_desc_en: A desk showing organization and a bridge showing safety.
words.image_desc_cn: 分别展示井井有条的办公桌和坚固安全的桥梁。
words.collocations: be responsible for, feel responsible, socially responsible

examples.en: He is responsible for cleaning the classroom every day after school.
examples.cn: 他负责每天放学后打扫教室。

examples.en: It is responsible to recycle and protect our environment together.
examples.cn: 一起回收利用和保护我们的环境是负责任的。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你答应帮助朋友完成一项任务，并且确保任务完成，你表现出什么品质？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词形容承担义务并确保完成任务的状态。

sentences: She is a ___ student and always completes her homework on time.

image_prompts: A hand holding a sign that reads 'Responsibility'
A blueprint of a building with annotations highlighting key structural components
words.image_desc_en: Responsibility sign and building blueprint.
words.image_desc_cn: 责任标志和建筑蓝图。
words.usage: 短语。承担责任，对某事或某人负责任。
words.collocations: be directly responsible for, be ultimately responsible for

examples.en: He will be responsible for organizing the school's annual sports day.
examples.cn: 他将负责组织学校一年一度的运动会。

examples.en: Our team is responsible for cleaning the classroom every Friday.
examples.cn: 我们小组负责每周五打扫教室。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你的宠物狗咬坏了邻居的花，谁应该承担赔偿的义务？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 考虑谁应该为狗的行为承担后果。

sentences: She will ___ taking care of her younger sister this summer.

image_prompts: A dotted line cutting through a piece of paper, dividing it into two distinct sections
Two piles of laundry, one light colors and one dark colors, neatly stacked
words.image_desc_en: Representing the action of dividing or keeping things apart.
words.image_desc_cn: 表示分开或使事物保持分离的动作。
words.meaning_cn: adj. 分离的；分开的；v. (separated, separated) 分开；分离
words.collocations: separate rooms, separate into groups, separate fact from fiction

examples.en: We should separate the trash into different bins for recycling.
examples.cn: 我们应该把垃圾分成不同的垃圾箱进行回收。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to separate into groups for the project.
examples.cn: 老师要求我们分成小组来完成这个项目。

socratic_questions.question: 如果需要把混合在一起的糖果，按照颜色进行分类，你会怎么做？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示将事物区分开，不再混合。

sentences: Please ___ the white clothes from the colored ones before washing.

image_prompts: A compass pointing towards a distant mountain range at sunrise
A map with a highlighted route leading from a city to a rural area
words.image_desc_en: A compass and a map showing the start of a journey.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个指南针和一张地图，显示旅程的开始。
words.meaning_cn: 出发，开始旅程；开始做某事
words.usage: v. (过去式 set out, 过去分词 set out)
words.collocations: set out on a journey, set out to do something

examples.en: They will set out early tomorrow morning for their trip.
examples.cn: 他们明天早上将早点出发去旅行。

examples.en: She set out to learn English well before the exam.
examples.cn: 她在考试前开始努力学英语。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你计划开始一次长途旅行，你会做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 需要表达“开始”的意思，并且是计划好的。

sentences: We ___ early in the morning to avoid the traffic jam.

image_prompts: A dotted line cutting a group of apples into two distinct clusters
A winding road diverging into two different paths at a fork in the road
words.image_desc_en: Objects or paths dividing into distinct groups or directions.
words.image_desc_cn: 物体或路径分成不同的组或方向。
words.usage: v. to keep apart or divide
words.collocations: separate the wheat from the chaff, separate fact from fiction

examples.en: We should separate the recyclable waste from the general rubbish.
examples.cn: 我们应该将可回收垃圾与一般垃圾分开。

examples.en: It's hard to separate my feelings from my work sometimes.
examples.cn: 有时候很难将我的情感从工作中分离出来。

socratic_questions.question: 如果把一堆混在一起的东西分成不同的几堆，你会怎么描述这个动作？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 强调将事物分开，不再混在一起。

sentences: Try to ___ your personal life ___ your professional life.
The teacher asked us to ___ the good apples ___ the bad ones.

image_prompts: A close-up of a bird's wing showing detailed feathers, sunlight shining through
An airplane wing with flaps extended during landing, clear blue sky
words.image_desc_en: A bird's wing and an airplane wing.
words.image_desc_cn: 鸟的翅膀和飞机的机翼。
words.collocations: under the wing, take wing

examples.en: The bird spread its wings and flew away quickly.
examples.cn: 鸟儿展开翅膀，迅速飞走了。

examples.en: The airplane's wing was damaged during the storm last night.
examples.cn: 昨晚的暴风雨中，飞机的机翼受损了。

socratic_questions.question: 鸟类和飞机依靠什么来飞行？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 它们都需要一个可以展开并提供升力的结构。

sentences: The butterfly has a beautiful pattern on its ___.

image_prompts: A flowchart illustrating the steps of a scientific experiment
A recipe book open to a page showing numbered instructions for baking a cake
words.image_desc_en: A flowchart and a recipe book showing step-by-step instructions.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张流程图和一本菜谱，展示了逐步的说明。
words.collocations: effective method, scientific method, different methods
words.preposition_combos: method of doing something, method for doing something

examples.en: The best method to learn English is to practice every day.
examples.cn: 学习英语最好的方法是每天练习。

examples.en: We need to find a better method to solve this difficult problem.
examples.cn: 我们需要找到一个更好的方法来解决这个难题。

socratic_questions.question: 当你想解决一个问题，你会遵循一定的步骤或计划吗？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指的是有条理地完成某事的过程。

sentences: What ___ did you use to solve this math problem so quickly?

image_prompts: A detailed blueprint with arrows and labels indicating assembly steps
A user manual lying open on a table, highlighting numbered steps
words.image_desc_en: A blueprint showing assembly steps; a user manual with numbered steps.
words.image_desc_cn: 一份显示组装步骤的蓝图；一本带有编号步骤的用户手册。
words.collocations: follow instructions, clear instructions, detailed instructions

examples.en: Read the instruction carefully before you start the exam paper.
examples.cn: 开始答题前，请仔细阅读说明。

examples.en: The teacher gave us clear instruction on how to solve the problem.
examples.cn: 老师给了我们关于如何解决这个问题的清晰指示。

socratic_questions.question: 当你购买一个新的电子产品时，通常会先看什么来了解如何使用它？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这通常是一份书面或图示的指南，告诉你如何操作。

sentences: Please follow the teacher's ___ carefully to complete the experiment.

image_prompts: A reflection of a chess piece in a mirror, showing two identical pieces
Two identical stacks of pancakes, one on top of the other
words.image_desc_en: Visuals representing duplication or doubling.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表复制或加倍的视觉效果。
words.collocations: double room, double check, double major

examples.en: The price of the book is double what I expected.
examples.cn: 这本书的价格是我预期的两倍。

examples.en: Please double check your answers before you hand in the test.
examples.cn: 请在交卷前仔细检查你的答案。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个苹果的价格是 2 元，两个苹果的价格是多少？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 描述的是数量上的加倍。

sentences: I had to pay ___ the price because I lost my ticket.

image_prompts: A calendar page with a specific date circled, indicating a future event
A handwritten note saying 'We shall overcome' on aged parchment
words.image_desc_en: A calendar marking a future date; a note with 'We shall overcome'.
words.image_desc_cn: 日历上标记着未来的日期；一张写着“我们必将克服”的纸条。
